metadata.purpose: Pair each source value with the provider reading taken during that value reaction.

conditions: Each successful read produces one fresh wrapper around the unchanged source payload.
Provider failure replaces the pending value with its exact error; source terminals and cancellation do not read time.
Neither operator schedules work or delays notifications.

scope.parameters: One valid, synchronous external now provider. Finite numeric readings; finite differences for timeInterval. Provider readings may be negative, fractional, repeated or decreasing.
scope.callbacks: Each provider.now request is an explicit invocation with no arguments. A correlated return or throw is supplied; the pure machine never calls a provider.
scope.time: Trace-envelope time is finite, nonnegative and nondecreasing. Provider readings are separate data and may move backwards. runClockTrace enforces same-envelope-time provider outcomes; no timer is introduced.
scope.reentrancy: Atomic non-reentrant reactions; synchronous callback outcomes are explicit microsteps. Ordered source teardown assumes source setup has returned.
exclusions: Nonfinite provider readings and numeric-overflow differences.
Clock-provider receiver/getter mutations, reentrant provider/observer actions, and consumer cancellation during a pending read.
Source delivery during acquisition is characterized natively; action ordering here assumes setup has returned.
Throwing observer/producer teardown, arbitrary reentrancy and universal infinite-trace liveness are not modeled.

initialization.sourceSubscription: First result connection acquires source directly; there is no initial clock read.

ownership.sharing: No implicit sharing or replay. Each result subscription owns its memory and resource generations; supplied producers may themselves be shared.
ownership.reset: Create fresh bookkeeping for each result connection. Payload objects are not cloned.

dispatch.actionSemantics: Ordered action words are model predictions, not executed effects. Callback invocation IDs correlate outcomes; they are not subscription IDs.
cancellationCheckpoints: Between external reactions. Cancellation during synchronous multi-action delivery is characterized separately, not silently admitted into this profile.

inputs.description: First connection to this result execution.
A value from the currently owned source subscription.
Source failure with an opaque error value.
Consumer closes the result connection silently.
Finite value returned by the currently pending synchronous provider read.
Opaque error thrown by the currently pending synchronous provider read.

controls.description: See the typed state and named transitions for Listening.
See the typed state and named transitions for ReadingNext.
Terminated; no owned subscriptions or retained values.

sources.purpose: Upstream scenario basis; test bodies inspected, not claimed to have been executed as the upstream suite.

actions: subscribe source; do not read provider yet
rules.explanation: timestamp reads only when a source value arrives; construction and connection do not request a timestamp.

rules.guard: source is live and next read index can advance safely
actions: retain exact value and request provider.now
rules.nextState: ReadingNext with the source value and correlated read index retained.
rules.explanation: No scheduler task is created. The read is part of the synchronous reaction to this value.

actions: emit a fresh record containing the same value and supplied timestamp
rules.nextState: Listening with no historical reading retained and nextRead advanced.
rules.explanation: The provider reading is copied as supplied, independently of the trace-envelope time.

actions: release source without forwarding pending value
rules.nextState: Closed error; pending value and baseline are discarded.
rules.explanation: The OperatorSubscriber catches a provider failure inside next and closes the existing source connection.

rules.guard: source completes while no read is pending
actions: release source; perform no clock read
rules.nextState: Closed complete with no retained memory.
rules.explanation: Terminal notifications are forwarded without time decoration.

rules.guard: source fails while no read is pending
actions: release source; perform no clock read
rules.nextState: Closed error with no retained memory.
rules.explanation: A source error does not request the clock or wrap the error payload.

actions: release source silently; perform no clock read
rules.explanation: Closing a connection is neither a decorated value nor a terminal notification.
